The real numbers are $\RR$. Both arguments of $\pair{x}{y}$ come from the
same style file used by this document.

$$\rankop(A) \leq \dim(V)$$

An optional argument can use its default or be supplied explicitly:

$$\shift{y} \qquad \shift[z]{y}$$
